approvedComponentGrowth.rationale: The approved Architecture v4.11 D15 redesign adds typed reusable-design, reusable-run, and captured-workbook Process worksheet controllers to the packaged Operations project. Slice 4ai adds one D14 Admin inventory worksheet staging controller. Slice 4ak corrects the existing Admin and Domain services without adding a component, legacy package, or parallel authority.

approvedProcedureGrowth.rationale: The approved D15 Process/Recipe lifecycle, graph editor, exact-entity allocator, ordered multi-output run engine, multi-table captured-workbook Process workbench, numbered assignment picker, text-safe table-wide row identity boundary, bulk DRAFT import, current exact-entity picker projection, OUTPUT managed-item picker/hidden-SKU round-trip, same-handler packaged selection/change tests, and bounded clean-restart probes add protected procedures. Slice 4ae adds shared Process-component identity protection; 4af adds Recipe identity/version initialization; 4ag adds actual-output persistence; and 4ah fixes Admin edit selection. Slice 4ai adds captured-workbook Admin inventory table creation, normalized-header preflight, ADD/EDIT application, row-status reporting, and same-handler packaged proof. Slice 4aj adds retained per-batch output history, Used Goods and Process Total calculations, active-row mapping, and Utility-aware inventory display. Slice 4ak adds exact managed-entity creation and catalog-only completion plus shared dropdown and non-counted-entity helpers. Slice 4al adds a guarded form delete handler, exact-key counted/non-counted retirement service, durable RETIRED projection, catalog retirement, and packaged Domain proof. Literal Application.Run targets and unresolved dynamic calls do not grow.

approvedCandidateGrowth.rationale: The scanner increase is bounded to the approved Process/Recipe surfaces plus the D14 Admin captured-workbook inventory worksheet controller, Slice 4ak exact-entity/dropdown same-handler evidence, and Slice 4al audit-preserving retirement handlers. Scanner findings remain review-only and authorize no deletion; duplicate-body and dynamic-call ratchets do not grow.

approvedDuplicateGrowth.rationale: Four scanner-normalized wrapper groups are retained deliberately: paired Process/Recipe refresh callbacks, paired New/Clear callbacks for each editor, and two primitive Inventory Domain query bridges. Each remains a distinct public or operator callback contract.

approvedModuleGrowth.rationale: Five operator-visible pages and their real action handlers replace the former single Recipe Builder surface; Slices 4y/4z/4aa/4ab/4ac/4ad add locked generated identities, separate Process workbench actions, numbered alternatives, Ctrl+click bulk DRAFT import, actual same-column INPUT/OUTPUT picker-open and commit proof, retained descriptive output Name, hidden output-SKU round-trip, and clean-restart diagnostics. Slice 4ae adds bounded public-handler proof that OUTPUT Name is suppressed and table-wide Base-36 row IDs stay unique and stable under order-dependent edits, plus load-boundary normalization for historical nonconforming draft component IDs. Slice 4af adds automatic Recipe identity initialization, editable positive-whole-number Recipe version validation, and actual New Recipe/Save Draft/Release evidence. Slice 4ag adds per-output Actual Output selection/change handling and packaged readable-header, Last Actual, and actual-inventory assertions. Slice 4aj retains completed batch rows and maps operator edits only to the active output rows while proving Used Goods, Process Total, and Utility display through the public run handler.

The preserved packaged launcher exposes bounded same-project reusable-design/run/workbench/restart test entry points, owns the shared three-character Base-36 generator and validator, routes Process INPUT and OUTPUT item search through Core, and converts automation-only faults into actionable test results.

Slices 4ab/4ac/4ad add a bounded Process-only Inventory Domain entity loader, SKU-level deduplication, packaged visible-result count, and OUTPUT visible-item/hidden-SKU commit branch without changing other picker modes or adding a parallel inventory authority.

The typed run controller owns graph loading, exact-key allocation, stale revalidation, ordered events, percentage/yield-basis scaling, per-output planned/actual state, routed-commitment validation, actual-quantity entity creation, retained per-batch output history, same-Process/output/UOM totals, Utility-aware inventory display, and two-batch state outside the already oversized form/controller. Slice 4ak permits an exact non-counted Utility/Service entity to satisfy usage allocation without inventing a tank quantity.

The cohesive typed worksheet controller owns simultaneous captured-workbook Process tables, calculated formula/validation columns, catalog UOM validation, text-safe generated identity, numbered INPUT assignment projections, same-column OUTPUT managed-item/hidden-SKU projection, Ctrl+click selected-only safe retrieval, and clean-restart discovery without creating a second Designs authority.

Slices 4ah/4ai add shared SKU-backed edit selection plus visible Create/Upload Inventory Table controls, captured-workbook binding, and same-handler packaged contracts for single-item and bulk workflows. Slice 4ak adds distinct-value editable Default Location and Category combos plus real Add handler evidence. Slice 4al adds the Edit-only Delete Item control, confirmation/reason boundary, and real-handler packaged proof.

Slices 4ah/4ai add typed packaged form entry points and bounded wrappers that route worksheet ADD/EDIT records through the existing catalog, event, processor, and quantity-adjustment authorities. Slice 4ak replaces blank-key migration Add with exact INVENTORY_CREATE, resolves displayed quantity from managed entities, and provides explicit catalog-only completion with a new System_Key. Slice 4al adds exact active-entity enumeration, counted/non-counted retirement payloads, catalog retirement metadata, and packaged payload evidence.

Slice 4ak preserves Utility/Service/Not Counted creation as a zero-quantity exact entity and records it ACTIVE during the authoritative ledger projection rebuild. Slice 4al validates exact-key retirement, admits only declared zero-delta non-counted retirement, rebuilds durable RETIRED state, and supplies an isolated packaged counted/Utility application proof.
Slice 4al removes RETIRED exact entities from the refreshed operator managed-inventory table while preserving snapshot-fed active rows and canonical history.
Slice 4ak keeps zero-quantity non-counted exact entities eligible for the Production managed-item picker while counted depleted entities remain excluded.

Slice 4ai's cohesive D14 controller owns uniquely named local inventory tables, configured dropdowns, normalized-header/custom-field ingestion, whole-table preflight, generated ADD Item Codes, exact EDIT identity, row outcomes, and packaged dry-run evidence without becoming inventory authority.
